fact: The article says Tunisia's entrepreneurial ecosystem is carried by a pioneering Startup Act.
The article describes the Startup Act as the legal framework promoting startups in Tunisia, on which the JICA programme draws.
The column cites 1,450 labelled startups in Tunisia.
Minister Sofiane Hmissi said a revised bill, Startup Act 2.0, is in preparation with the Ministry of Economy and Planning, keeping the earlier legal framework.
Agence Ecofin reports that about 1,400 enterprises hold the 'Start-up' label in 2026, with the government aiming for 2,000 in 2027.
